title: Coarse threshold property
statement: Let $d:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$, and let $(f_k)_{k\in\mathbb N}$ be a family of Boolean functions such that each $f_k$ is monotone and nonconstant on the $d(k)$-dimensional cube. For $0<\epsilon<\tfrac12$, the family has a coarse threshold precisely when it does not have a sharp threshold.
hypotheses_covered: For every $k$, a Boolean function on the $d(k)$-dimensional cube
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the critical probability or bias-variance scale used to define a sharp threshold.
